description: When words came into the law and when they left it, at any date and in every jurisdiction: each change whose added or removed text contains them. Use it for things no longer in force (for example "COVID" in the Grundgesetz).

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction: a country by its name in English or its own language ("germany", "Deutschland", "UK") or its ISO code ("de"), or a path prefix, for example "germany", "united-states/federal" or "united-kingdom/uk/legislation/uksi".

kind.description: laws (default; "law" is read the same): law only. judgments: court decisions (case law) only. all: both. A jurisdiction that names case law (a path ending in /caselaw) reads it too.

max_results.description: At most this many (default 40, at most 300).

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next_offset the answer before gave in "page" (default 0).

query.description: Words or a phrase to trace, as plain text (either case, and dashes and quotes in any of their forms, match); a regular expression if regex is true.

regex.description: Read query as a regular expression (POSIX extended, as git grep -E reads it) instead of plain text (default false).

name: phrase_history
title: Phrase history
